_comment: Manual alternative to `guardrails.py install-hooks` (preferred: it also pins your guardrails.json path and a SHA-256 of config + packs, so policy edits fail closed). Merge into .claude/settings.json and replace /path/to/agent-guardrails with your clone's absolute path; without the pin the hook reads /path/to/agent-guardrails/guardrails.json. Universal matcher (.*) sends every tool through the hook, and the sh -c wrapper turns any non-zero exit into 2 (block).
